title: Office Battlefield - Things You Only See After Leaving
summary: Nearly three weeks after leaving the team, Jason sees what the office whiteboard, farewell gestures, messages from David and Geoffrey, and lingering friendships reveal about belonging.

portal.scene: Jason faces a mountain-roadtrip drawing still on the office whiteboard, while a phone, farewell keepsakes, an umbrella, and former colleagues circle the scene.
